question: Which divine forms were placed in the eastern and northeastern directions?
premises: Nāndī was placed in the east
Mādhava named Matsyākṣa was placed in the northeast
inference: Nāndī was placed in the east and Mādhava called Matsyākṣa in the northeast.
uncertainties: nāndīm case/identity as placed form is slightly ambiguous
plain_english: In the east was Nāndī, and in the northeast Mādhava named Matsyākṣa.
